verses.text: I do not really need to write to you about this gift for God's people.

I know how eager you are to help. I have been telling the people in Macedonia how proud I am of you. I told them that you in Achaia have been ready to give since last year. Your eagerness has stirred most of them to act.
But I am sending the brothers so that our pride in you will not turn out to be empty. I want you to be ready, as I said you would be.
If some people from Macedonia come with me and find that you are not ready, we would be ashamed of being so sure of you, not to mention how ashamed you would be.
So I thought I should ask the brothers to visit you before I come. They will make sure the gift you promised is ready ahead of time. Then it will be a gift given freely, not one forced out of you.
Remember this: whoever plants only a few seeds will harvest only a little. Whoever plants many seeds will harvest a lot.
Each of you should give what you have decided in your heart to give. Do not give unwillingly or because you feel forced. God loves a person who gives gladly.
And God is able to give you more than enough of every blessing. Then you will always have everything you need, and plenty left over for every good work.
As it is written, "He gives freely to the poor. His goodness lasts for ever."
God gives seed to the farmer and bread to eat. He will also give you plenty of seed and make it grow, so that your good deeds will bring a large harvest.
He will make you rich in every way, so that you can always give freely. And when we take your gifts to those in need, they will thank God.
This work of giving does more than meet the needs of God's people. It also overflows in many thanks to God.

Your giving proves what you are. People will praise God because you obey the good news of Christ that you say you believe. They will praise him because you share so freely with them and with everyone.
And they will pray for you with deep love, because of the great grace God has given you.
Thanks be to God for his gift, which is too wonderful for words!
